method.order: Before/after order alternates by repetition; no browser or GPU workload is started by this helper.
method.timing: Native performance.now elapsed milliseconds and process.cpuUsage deltas; constructor, bundling and hashing are outside timing.
method.equivalence: All current geometry attribute/index buffers, both instance matrices, draw counts, uniforms and public snapshot hashed; resource budgets compared.
limits: Three.js constructors and update methods run in Node without WebGL.
Measures algorithmic CPU work, not browser renderSubmit/GPU stalls, physical device FPS, power or battery.

method.probe: Production constructor wrapper + forwarded native WebGL API and shadow render timing; actual native RAFs only. Instrumented diagnosis, not an uninstrumented performance benchmark.
notes: CPU4 is enabled only after room entry and preparation; load/entry times are CPU1 observations.
Callback/update/renderSubmit are elapsed main-thread timings and may include driver stalls. They are not GPU-completion time or physical-device FPS.
CDP Task/Script/Layout/Style metrics overlap; do not sum them. JS heap excludes GPU/browser-process memory.

GL forwarding includes two performance.now calls per measured native GL call; counters and argument summaries add overhead. Use the same instrumentation for paired versions. No getError/finish/fence query is inserted into measured frames.
GL, shadow and renderer timings nest and overlap; never sum them. CPU profiling/trace further adds diagnostic overhead.
Default thunder=0 provides a steady rain/wave/cloth workload matching the visual baseline, excluding lightning peaks. Use --thunder=1 for a separately labeled natural-storm sample.
URL debug date is reset after entry; native time then advances normally. Sampling never freezes or accelerates the page clock.

mapping.method: Sort completed FireAnimationFrame events. Exclude the first trace-start overhang RAF; the remaining32 match measured probe frames in order, with ~2.4ms spread in native-trace timestamp minus JS frame start. Include native ReadPixels starts from first matched RAF until the following open RAF, so the selection is a native frame interval, not exactly the point-in-time probe enable/disable window.

sourceEvidence.paintBehavior: paint(previous,current) redraws two512-high rows and marks atlas.needsUpdate; its live minute change is the recurrent room canvas-upload path. Source dimensions match the recorded native HTMLCanvasElement upload; no book interaction occurred in this baseline.

clockAtlasStall.attribution: The one456.2ms native HTMLCanvasElement texSubImage2D dominates the503.8ms drawn frame and486.5ms renderer submit. Native CPU-profiler456.612ms self weight independently agrees. This directly locates a canvas-texture upload stall; it does not attribute every browser frame interval to that upload.

outsideJSReadback.interpretation: Native renderer-thread GLES2::ReadPixels calls occur immediately after RAF callback returns and wait on GPU command-buffer completion. They are absent from the forwarded application JS readPixels call log. This identifies native readback/presentation synchronization outside the JS callback in this software-rendering configuration; not an application readPixels loop or a physical-device measurement.

limits: Native GL, renderer, shadow and nested GPU wait/flush spans overlap; do not sum them.
CPU profile timeDeltas are wall sampling weights including native waits and trace-start overhang, not CPU utilization. Inclusive source weights overlap.
The measured32 callbacks and the selected32 native presentation intervals are closely mapped but have different exact start/end capture boundaries.
No new shader compilation was observed from stable program/resource counts; this alone is not a proof that all driver/cache work is absent.
This trace uses instrumented GL forwarding and CPU4x software WebGL; no physical-device FPS, battery or global latency non-regression inference.
Clock upload/source correlation is direct for this captured event; remaining native presentation cost has not been removed by an application code change in this diagnosis.

rejectedData.candidate: initial synchronous CPU-canvas to DataTexture clock candidate, not accepted performance result

traceOnlyCallbackStatistics.mappingStatus: Unmeasured trace boundary callbacks are not removed here. Exact probe-frame mapping waits for final profile JSON, since the extra callback need not always be at the start.

clockPathSignals.source: Built candidate uses CPU Canvas2D willReadFrequently, synchronous getImageData(2048x1024), and an8MiB Uint8Array view assigned to the DataTexture before needsUpdate.
clockPathSignals.finding: The initial candidate still exhibits substantial synchronous image-readback work plus slow typed-array GL uploads. The captured large frame stalls have not been eliminated; a change of texture source API alone is not a performance win.
clockPathSignals.cpuProfilerCaution: Self timeDeltas are wall sampling weights under CPU4x, including parked/throttled time; not exact method spans or physical CPU utilization. The tiny qualityPolicy.sample method also gets777.261ms self weight, so ranking alone must not be treated as literal CPU cost.

outsideJSReadbacks.interpretation: Native renderer-thread readbacks remain roughly1.9s each outside application JS readPixels forwarding; nested native wait spans overlap and must not be added.

limits: This is an initial candidate investigation, not accepted final optimization evidence.

The before and after captures deliberately have different native durations/minute coverage (32frames/~61s versus34frames/~69s); compare identifiable events, not global P95 as a statistical conclusion.
CPU profile inclusive/self weights overlap with native waits and CPU-throttling parking; do not interpret them as exact CPU spans.
The trace can include a callback before or after the timed probe. A first-callback exclusion copied from before would be unsafe without final-frame alignment.
Software renderer presentation waits remain a separate observed issue from the application clock atlas upload.
The post-measurement book smoke and screenshots are outside this closed trace and do not alter these captured timings.

finalFrameMapping.method: Choose the contiguous native complete-RAF sequence with the smallest sum absolute native-duration versus probe-duration differences, then verify trace-minus-JS-start offset spread; no hard-coded initial overhang removal.

clockTileUploadEvidence.attribution: The baseline 2048x1024 whole clock atlas upload was replaced by two unchanged512x512 minute-cell copies per sampled normal minute transition. Both sampled clock events retain mip generation and native Three copy state handling. No full2048x1024 clock Canvas upload occurs in the timed long-call log. The worst single tile is111.1ms, the two copies122.3ms combined inside a248.5ms frame. outsideJSReadback.interpretation: All32 selected renderer-thread native GLES2::ReadPixels start after their matched JS RAF callback has ended. No application JS readPixels was forwarded in the timed capture. Native presentation/readback synchronizes software GPU command completion outside application callbacks; it remains dominant and was not fixed by the clock change.

comparison.verdict: Accept the targeted byte reduction, exact clock visuals and reduced sampled clock-spike maximum. Do not claim overall FPS/P95 improvement: total callback P95 is89.1ms versus88.3ms, and native presentation waits are longer in this candidate capture. Short one-run samples have unequal wall durations/minute coverage and host scheduling varies.

bookSmoke.timing: All seven steps occur after the closed measured GL/CDP trace; do not include smoke wall times as performance samples.

Observed clock-spike maxima and bytes support a targeted improvement, not a statistical P95/FPS, physical-device, battery, cross-browser or broad no-regression claim.
The before and candidate captures have different wall durations and run at separate host times. Native driver/presentation waits grew in this sample and remain unresolved.

verdict.accepted: Fixed canonical clock atlas with dirty tile uploads; exact existing pixels, mipmaps, animation and GPU resource counts retained. Album immutable texture storage lifecycle and numerically equivalent pier reset optimization also accepted.

clockTransfer.limits: First transition may transfer one tile; hour/date/burst can require more, up to the original complete atlas. Each copy regenerates the original full mip chain; optional staging failure falls back to full upload.

singleRunObservations.warning: After normally requires two tile copies. These are observed per-call maxima, not equal-size throughput measurements. Callback P95 did not improve and the browser presentation bottleneck remains; no overall FPS or universal speedup claim.

import pathlib,subprocess,json,hashlib,re,datetime,urllib.parse
root=pathlib.Path.cwd(); work=root/'.work/frame-stall-20261119'
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
read=lambda n:json.loads((work/n).read_text())
base='5ded761'
allowed_source={'src/album-model.ts','src/desk-clock.ts','src/pier-surf.ts'}
allowed_tests={'tests/album-texture-lifecycle.spec.ts','tests/pier-impact-cache.spec.ts','tests/desk-clock-upload.spec.ts','tests/fixtures/desk-clock-reference.ts'}
allowed_docs={'README.md','AGENTS.md','MODIFICATION-PLAN.md','FRAME-STALL-INVESTIGATION.md'}
tracked=set(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only',base],text=True).splitlines())
untracked=set(subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard'],text=True).splitlines())
allchanged=tracked|untracked
allowed_artifacts={f'benchmark/frame-stall-2026-11-19-{name}.trace.json.gz' for name in ['baseline','rejectedData','limitedCpuHint','accepted']}|{'benchmark/frame-stall-2026-11-19.json','benchmark/frame-stall-2026-11-19-book-desktop.png','benchmark/frame-stall-2026-11-19-book-phone.png'}
unexpected=sorted(p for p in allchanged if p not in allowed_source|allowed_tests|allowed_docs|allowed_artifacts)
source_changed=sorted(p for p in allchanged if p.startswith(('src/','public/','docs/')))
assert set(source_changed)==allowed_source,source_changed
assert not unexpected,unexpected
fixture=(root/'tests/fixtures/desk-clock-reference.ts').read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)
original=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',base+':src/desk-clock.ts'])
restored=''.join(fixture[3:]).replace('../../src/desk-clock-time','./desk-clock-time').encode()
assert restored==original
assert sha(restored)=='ed9ad45a1ef1ea949ab23cb28ea92f2edf7b60e8f6c81a6841d85175c68f95ca'
def rows(text):
 out=[]
 for line in text.splitlines():
  cells=[v.strip() for v in line.split('|')[1:-1]]
  if len(cells)==5 and re.fullmatch(r'\d{2}\.\d{2}',cells[0]):out.append(cells)
 return out
oldrows=rows(subprocess.check_output(['git','show',base+':MODIFICATION-PLAN.md'],text=True));newrows=rows((root/'MODIFICATION-PLAN.md').read_text())
assert len(oldrows)==len(newrows)==47 and oldrows==newrows
counts={v:sum(r[2]==v for r in newrows) for v in ['修改','保留并验收','暂缓','待决定']}
completed=sum(r[3]=='是' for r in newrows)
assert completed==32 and list(counts.values())==[18,14,2,13],(counts,completed)
assets=[]
for n in ['before-dist','candidate3-dist']:
 p=work/n;assets.append({str(f.relative_to(p)):sha(f.read_bytes()) for f in p.rglob('*') if f.is_file()})
a,b=assets
common=a.keys()&b.keys()
asset_compare={'beforeFiles':len(a),'afterFiles':len(b),'identicalCommonFiles':sum(a[k]==b[k] for k in common),'onlyBefore':sorted(a.keys()-b.keys()),'onlyAfter':sorted(b.keys()-a.keys()),'changedCommon':sorted(k for k in common if a[k]!=b[k])}
assert len(a)==len(b)==32 and asset_compare['identicalCommonFiles']==30
profile=read('candidate3-profile.json');s=profile['samples'][0]
asset_fingerprints=[]
for p in s['probeAssets']:
 local=work/'candidate3-dist'/p['url'].split('http://127.0.0.1:4193/',1)[1]
 actual=sha(local.read_bytes());assert actual==p['originalSHA256']
 asset_fingerprints.append({'path':str(local.relative_to(root)),'sha256':actual,'matchesProfile':True})
pier_benchmark=read('pier-benchmark.json');pier_after=sha((root/'src/pier-surf.ts').read_bytes());assert pier_benchmark['sourceHashes']['after']==pier_after
test=read('candidate3-regression.json');stats=test['stats'];assert stats['expected']==23 and stats['unexpected']==stats['skipped']==stats['flaky']==0
cases=[]
def walk(v):
 for spec in v.get('specs',[]):
  for t in spec['tests']:
   for result in t['results']:
    cases.append({'file':spec['file'],'title':spec['title'],'status':result['status'],'retry':result['retry']})
 for suite in v.get('suites',[]):walk(suite)
walk(test);assert len(cases)==23 and all(c['status']=='passed' and c['retry']==0 for c in cases)
links=[];missing=[]
for name in sorted(allowed_docs):
 text=(root/name).read_text()
 for match in re.finditer(r'!?\[[^\]\n]*\]\(([^\n]+?)\)',text):
  raw=match.group(1).strip(); target=raw[1:raw.find('>')] if raw.startswith('<') else raw.split(' ',1)[0]
  parsed=urllib.parse.urlparse(target)
  if parsed.scheme or parsed.netloc or target.startswith('#'):continue
  path=urllib.parse.unquote(parsed.path)
  if not path:continue
  candidate=((root/name).parent/path).resolve()
  entry={'document':name,'target':target,'exists':candidate.exists()};links.append(entry)
  if not entry['exists']:missing.append(entry)
report={'checkedAtUTC':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'baseline':base,'scope':{'sourceChanged':source_changed,'testsAdded':sorted(allowed_tests),'unexpectedFiles':unexpected},'fixture':{'byteExactAfterDocumentedRelocation':True,'sha256':sha(restored)},'original47':{'rows':len(newrows),'allFiveFieldsByteTextEqual':True,'completed':completed,'decisions':counts},'defaultBuildAssets':asset_compare,'profileAssetFingerprints':asset_fingerprints,'pierBenchmarkSourceSHA256':{'current':pier_after,'recordedAfter':pier_benchmark['sourceHashes']['after'],'matches':True},'finalRegression':{'stats':stats,'cases':cases},'currentSourceAndTestSHA256':{p:sha((root/p).read_bytes()) for p in sorted(allowed_source|allowed_tests)},'docLinks':{'count':len(links),'missing':missing,'checks':links},'limitations':['Read-only static guard; no application test, browser or build rerun.','Current source/test hashes are recorded here; prior test report does not itself embed source hashes. Production profile asset hash matches accepted immutable build.','Document files may still be edited by docs agent; rerun this static guard after docs freeze.']}
(work/'delivery-guard.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'scopePass':not unexpected,'fixturePass':True,'rows47Unchanged':True,'counts':counts,'completed':completed,'assets':asset_compare,'testStats':stats,'linksChecked':len(links),'missingLinks':missing},ensure_ascii=False))
